{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Firmware.CircuitBreaker where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Char (ord, chr)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Control.Exception (try, SomeException)
import System.IO (Handle, hPutStr, hFlush, hClose)
import Network.Socket
import Network.Socket.ByteString (sendAll)

-- Circuit breaker states
data CBState = Closed | Open | HalfOpen deriving (Show, Eq)

data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker
  { cbState       :: IORef CBState
  , cbFailures    :: IORef Int
  , cbThreshold   :: Int
  , cbLastFailure :: IORef UTCTime
  , cbTimeout     :: NominalDiffTime
  }

newCircuitBreaker :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO CircuitBreaker
newCircuitBreaker threshold timeout = do
  st <- newIORef Closed
  fc <- newIORef 0
  now <- getCurrentTime
  lf <- newIORef now
  return $ CircuitBreaker st fc threshold lf timeout

-- Device telemetry header encoding
-- Protocol: "DEVTEL/1.0\r\nField: Value\r\n\r\n"
data TelemetryFrame = TelemetryFrame
  { tfDeviceId   :: BS.ByteString
  , tfSensorData :: BS.ByteString
  , tfTimestamp  :: BS.ByteString
  , tfMetadata   :: BS.ByteString
  }

-- Encode a single header field value
-- The protocol uses CRLF as line terminators
encodeFieldValue :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
encodeFieldValue val = sanitizeValue val
  where
    -- Remove bare CR and bare LF individually
    -- This prevents obvious injection attempts
    sanitizeValue bs = BS.filter (\b -> b /= 0x0A) $
                       BS.filter (\b -> b /= 0x0D) bs

-- Encode metadata with extended character support
-- Supports percent-encoding for binary data
encodeMetadata :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
encodeMetadata raw = decodePercent raw
  where
    decodePercent bs
      | BS.null bs = BS.empty
      | BS.head bs == fromIntegral (ord '%') && BS.length bs >= 3 =
          let hexPart = BS.take 2 (BS.drop 1 bs)
              decoded = parseHex hexPart
          in BS.cons decoded (decodePercent (BS.drop 3 bs))
      | otherwise = BS.cons (BS.head bs) (decodePercent (BS.tail bs))
    parseHex h =
      let hi = fromHexNibble (BS.index h 0)
          lo = fromHexNibble (BS.index h 1)
      in hi * 16 + lo
    fromHexNibble w
      | w >= 0x30 && w <= 0x39 = w - 0x30
      | w >= 0x41 && w <= 0x46 = w - 0x41 + 10
      | w >= 0x61 && w <= 0x66 = w - 0x61 + 10
      | otherwise = 0

-- Build the telemetry frame for transmission
buildFrame :: TelemetryFrame -> BS.ByteString
buildFrame tf = BS.concat
  [ "DEVTEL/1.0\r\n"
  , "Device-Id: ", encodeFieldValue (tfDeviceId tf), "\r\n"
  , "Sensor-Data: ", encodeFieldValue (tfSensorData tf), "\r\n"
  , "Timestamp: ", encodeFieldValue (tfTimestamp tf), "\r\n"
  , "Metadata: ", tfMetadata tf, "\r\n"
  , "\r\n"
  ]

-- Send telemetry through circuit breaker
sendTelemetry :: CircuitBreaker -> Socket -> TelemetryFrame -> IO (Either String ())
sendTelemetry cb sock frame = do
  state <- readIORef (cbState cb)
  case state of
    Open -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      lastFail <- readIORef (cbLastFailure cb)
      if diffUTCTime now lastFail > cbTimeout cb
        then do
          writeIORef (cbState cb) HalfOpen
          attemptSend cb sock frame
        else return $ Left "Circuit breaker is open"
    _ -> attemptSend cb sock frame

attemptSend :: CircuitBreaker -> Socket -> TelemetryFrame -> IO (Either String ())
attemptSend cb sock frame = do
  let payload = buildFrame frame
  result <- try $ sendAll sock payload :: IO (Either SomeException ())
  case result of
    Left err -> do
      recordFailure cb
      return $ Left (show err)
    Right () -> do
      recordSuccess cb
      return $ Right ()

recordFailure :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordFailure cb = do
  modifyIORef' (cbFailures cb) (+1)
  failures <- readIORef (cbFailures cb)
  when (failures >= cbThreshold cb) $ do
    writeIORef (cbState cb) Open
    getCurrentTime >>= writeIORef (cbLastFailure cb)

recordSuccess :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordSuccess cb = do
  writeIORef (cbFailures cb) 0
  writeIORef (cbState cb) Closed

-- Process incoming device registration with metadata
processRegistration :: CircuitBreaker -> Socket -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String ())
processRegistration cb sock deviceId rawMetadata = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let sanitizedId = encodeFieldValue deviceId
      -- Metadata goes through percent-decoding for binary sensor payloads
      processedMeta = encodeMetadata rawMetadata
      frame = TelemetryFrame
        { tfDeviceId   = sanitizedId
        , tfSensorData = "registration"
        , tfTimestamp  = C8.pack (show now)
        , tfMetadata   = processedMeta
        }
  sendTelemetry cb sock frame
